fingerprint: low b bits of original MurmurHash3 seed11 on uint64 little-endian key
placement: unchanged original four partitions, MurmurHash3 seeds0..3; fingerprint does not drive placement
count: original signed int32 state /25-bit wire, unchanged
wire: original bitpacked wire with 30-bit key,25-bit count and b fingerprint bits; byte tail padding
construction: build original full A/B 32-bit states once per dataset, mask only cell fingerprints for each b; XOR linearity validated against directly built truncated states
success: native decoder reports completion AND exact signed ground truth after decoding; no truth used during decoding
limit_policy: limits count as failures and are reported separately; no success filtering/retries; native peeling order and first-partition empty test preserved
uncertainty: Wilson95 per bit width over 100 independent input pairs; widths paired within each input
scope: ordinary IBLT only; not SC or Rateless; fixed cell count, no retuning
